attempts.summary: Configured a persistent UFW host firewall on node1: SSH (22/tcp) allowed from anywhere, TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.56.11), and rejected from node3 (10.100.56.12) and everywhere else. Verified functionally with live listener/connection tests, confirmed UFW enabled at boot, and performed the mandatory sequential restart of all three nodes with boot-ID proof of restart and post-restart re-verification.
